checks.omitted_qualifications: The risk factor states no revenue to date and the XML shows zero revenue for the most recent year. The prior-year zero is in the XML but was not quoted. checks.omitted_qualifications: The three figures match the audited pages. The 'older statement (G2)' label and the 'below one year of outflow' comparison are inferences. $19,213 is less than the $50,743 outflow, which is simple arithmetic. The outflow was offset by $50,704 of note proceeds that the statements classify under investing activities.

checks.note_ko: p.45와 p.48이 현금 $19,213, 영업현금흐름 -$50,743, 총부채 $268,348을 뒷받침합니다. G2 분류와 1년치 유출 대비 부족은 추론이며 산술적으로 타당합니다. 더 최근 현금(2026-06-18)은 별도 사실입니다.

checks.omitted_qualifications: The Note 4 passage is a management statement. The founder's intent is not a commitment, which the claim notes. The absence of a going-concern paragraph in the audit report was seen only on p.43, not the full report. The substantial-doubt text is the issuer's risk factor, not audited.

checks.note_ko: p.12의 계속기업 의구 표현과 p.51 주석 4의 창업자 지원 의사·크라우드펀딩 계획이 각각 확인됩니다. 창업자 지원이 확정 약정이 아니라는 점은 문서와 일치합니다. 감사보고서 전체에 해당 문단이 없다는 판단은 p.43만 근거로 합니다.

The cited quotes do not show the milestone list (p.27), the issuer's risk factor (p.13) or that the human trial cost is unstated. Those parts rest on other pages or are absences.

The absence of any plan or cap on issuing the remaining authorized shares is an absence statement. The issuance date and consideration are not stated, as the claim says.

'Not convertible in this Offering' matches p.32 and p.34. The term says 'senior debt obligation... in certain scenarios', so seniority is qualified and should not be read as a documented liquidation ranking.
